messages:
morgan (product): Quick sync — we need to align on a legal-discovery + data lifecycle playbook for enterprise launch next quarter. Main asks from customers: fast e-discovery search, per-tenant export, legal-hold snapshots, and tiered retention (7/30/90). @ana (legal) @josh (security) can you weigh in on gaps?
ana (legal): TL;DR — legal wants 3 guarantees: 1) preservation (legal hold) that prevents deletion, 2) tamper-evident chain-of-custody metadata with attestations, 3) ability to request a signed export (ndjson) within an SLA (48–72h). Also need coverage in SOC2 evidence pack.
josh (security): Notes from infra/security: we already have archival S3 tiers but not an indexed e-discovery pipeline. Indexing every event will increase cost ~3x and add indexing latency. Two feasible patterns: full index (fast queries) or cold raw export with async reindex-on-demand. BYOK for exports raises key-escrow questions — if customer keys are required for retrieval, legal may need an escrow option.
priya (platform): Platform options to propose: a) Index-everything mode for Dedicated customers (fast search, higher cost), b) Prefix/index-selection (customer chooses what to index) for hosted, c) Async reindex/export job that builds queryable index on-demand. API surface: /v1/retention/policies, /v1/legal/holds, /v1/exports. Need to spec retention policy semantics (policy inheritance, override).
kevin (sales): Customer signal — a large enterprise said they'd pay for an "audit+fast-search" add-on if SLAs and export formats are clear. They need a billing plan and a demo that shows a legal-hold snapshot and a signed export.
nana (legal): Proposed launch criteria from legal side: - legal-hold snapshot that is immutable, - signed export with manifest (hash + signer), - documented BYOK handshake and consent flow, - retrieval SLA documented and tested, - basic chain-of-custody metadata fields. Format preference: ndjson or gzipped ndjson.
priya (platform): Prototype rollout plan suggestion: Q1: implement retention policy API and on-demand export job (async reindex). Q2: build index pipeline + query UI for fast e-discovery (Dedicated first). Need decisions on default retention tiers and retention inheritance behavior. Also need to design signal for exports so billing can attach to invoices.
josh (security): Security considerations: - BYOK key management: support customer-managed keys (CMEK) + optional escrow with strict access controls and audit trail. - Attestation: HSM-signed manifests preferred. - Tamper-evidence: signed hashes stored immutably. I'll draft a minimal BYOK escrow flow.
morgan (product): Action items: Priya -> PR draft API spec by EOW; Josh -> sketch BYOK+escrow options; Ana -> draft legal-hold acceptance language + evidence fields; Kevin -> confirm willingness-to-pay + requirements from the customer. @ci-bot can you create an epic for this?
ci-bot: Created epic ED-LIFECYCLE-2387654321 and linked tickets: retention-api-238765, export-job-238766, byok-handshake-238767, ed-ui-proto-238768.
priya (platform): Example retention policy snippet (working prototype):
```yaml
policy_id: "customer-123-default"
retention_days: 90
hold: false
index_prefixes: ["audit.events", "user.messages.summary"]
immutable_on_hold: true
```
josh (security): Perf note: full indexing prototype showed 30% CPU delta and +2.5x storage for our test workload (50M events/day). We should gate full-index on Dedicated / paid add-on.
nana (legal): Once we have the draft API + keyflow we'll run a compliance review (SOC2/ISO) — chain-of-custody + legal-hold are blocker items for certification evidence.
morgan (product): Great — let's run a short sync next Tue after drafts. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
